description: API access, one page of truth (GET /v1/access): the products one key rents (RPC, proofs, decoded events, the coordination API, grades), each with its calls, its price per 1,000 in GRID and USDC, its free allowance and limits, and what it measured over the last 24 h; the chains and methods of the RPC gateway; how a key is topped up. With view "key": your key’s permissions, budgets, balance and rate (GET /v1/access/key). With view "usage": what your key used per product family over window 1d | 7d | 30d | month (GET /v1/access/usage). key and usage need your key (api_key, or the X-API-Key header on this server).
name: taifoon_access
